[attribute-source-id-type]
=== `@source-id-type` Source Identifier Type (in Related Object)

Type of source identifier (for example, a DOI, ISSN, ISBN, or publisher’s identifier) for a <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| The type of identifier that names the source of the related object, for example, a
                        DOI| The type of document identifier named in the <<attribute-source-id,`@source-id`>> attribute for a (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>) element. This attribute qualifies the <<attribute-source-id,`@source-id`>> attribute.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
